(i) data splitting can be a very accurate approach to big-data learning, but (ii) in a high-dimensional regime it can incur a significant accuracy loss, which (iii) can be mitigated by deploying a sufficiently large number of machines.

In the fixed-$P$ setting, data splitting incurs no first-order error.
